thesis: Four defeasible empirical hypotheses complement narrow provable propositions.
role: Give the program explicit claims that can fail and bounded formal foundations.

ideas.statement: Updatable states may improve cost–fidelity frontiers, passive compression may lose causal distinctions, reusable operations may amortize costs, and memory may need both expansion and reorganization.
Shortcut savings require reuse exceeding discovery and verification costs, including selection and maintenance rather than changed output requirements.
Computable changing rules admit extended fixed dynamics; compatible TV approximation errors add; exact states must distinguish incompatible continuations.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Separating finitely many candidate models has sample bounds under explicit test gaps and independence assumptions.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Test estimation does not ensure model identification, and structural reorganization may cost more than it saves.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
